The **Sheepsquatch Club** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A club consisting of a Sheepsquatch Skull mounted to a wooden handle with rope. It has a high amount of base damage for a one-handed melee weapon.

This weapon and the Sheepsquatch Staff were created by Connor McCampbell, based on a concept by Jacob Raymor. He used Ian Olsen's character model for the Sheepsquatch as a starting point, and art director Jonathan Rush provided a real sheep skull for reference. [Dev 1]
